leftEvidence.title: Death to law and union with the raised Christ lead toward fruit and new service

points.label: Change in allegiance
points.left: Readers die to the law through Christ’s body and belong to the raised one.
points.right: Those who live are no longer to live for themselves but for the one who died and rose.

points.label: Named result
points.left: Fruit for God and service in newness of Spirit are named.
points.right: Changed perception and new creation are named.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Christ’s death and rising redirect the living and introduce new creation

payload.tension: Both passages connect the raised Christ with changed life while using different analogies, agents, and named outcomes.
payload.title: Fruit for God / life no longer centered on self
